package contract

import "context"

type Resource interface {
	InsertOne(context.Context, Request) (Row, error)
	InsertOptional(context.Context, Request) (*Row, error)
	InsertMany(context.Context, Request) ([]Row, error)
	InsertCount(context.Context, Request) (uint64, error)
	UpdateOne(context.Context, Request) (Row, error)
	UpdateOptional(context.Context, Request) (*Row, error)
	UpdateMany(context.Context, Request) ([]Row, error)
	UpdateCount(context.Context, Request) (uint64, error)
	DeleteOne(context.Context, Filter) (Row, error)
	DeleteOptional(context.Context, Filter) (*Row, error)
	DeleteMany(context.Context, Filter) ([]Row, error)
	DeleteCount(context.Context, Filter) (uint64, error)
	Clear(context.Context, Empty) (uint64, error)
}

type Empty struct{}
type Filter struct{ Key int64 }
type Request struct {
	Key    int64
	Text   string
	Active bool
	Token  []byte
	Score  float64
}
type Row struct {
	Key            int64
	Text           string
	Active         bool
	Token          []byte
	Score          float64
	OptionalKey    *int64
	OptionalText   *string
	OptionalActive *bool
	OptionalToken  *[]byte
	OptionalScore  *float64
}
